3077079169.annotation: Upgrading to opening rounds (see anno) early is nice and helps Rem's projectile speed. Interchangable 1st item with Headshotbooster and Grit.

1150006784.annotation: Provides more healing than imp spirit because of the extra duration it gives + 20 spirit (Works on all ur jumps)

619484391.annotation: Mega strong with 2 & sup duration (4+ sec silence)

2922054143.annotation: Anti M1 Early, builds into Disarming Hex

1932939246.annotation: Use in 2 for range (max 2 gives this more damage) or get torment up to you

1644605047.annotation: Works with the spirit amp on 2

1152158042.annotation: Mega late upgrade if you bought slow hex

2081037738.annotation: if you have alot of spirit heros on team

2829638276.annotation: Mathmatically correct item for sustain in lane, you kinda perma push with monster rounds and helpers so only go if you're STRUGGLING. This builds into healing booster and healing tempo so, it's good!

4204808176.annotation: Good into viscous, calico, drifter, abrahms, and billy early because of your negative melee resist

3731635960.annotation: I like this item a lot, I don't go it all the time especially since I kinda use Tag Along to dodge big abilities but this is nice if youre getting slowing hexxed or movement locked a lot!

395867183.annotation: Free spirit scaling gun dmg every 8 seconds. Potential to do around 300~ dmg late game.

3585132399.annotation: I like it so that I don't have to waste TG to get a lil extra healing outside of fights, but needs further testing.

493591231.annotation: Makes your ult pretty good whenever you get it.

2142980412.annotation: Huge item. For you to hard focus a single person out. Preferably whoever on the enemy team is carrying/snowballing

3028234315.annotation: Buffed AGAIN: 22% spirit resist. Best protections in the game imo.

1955841979.annotation: When they have a lot AND I MEAN A LOT of burst dmg. Like im talking bout fr getting one shot by spirit characters. Not 3 shot, not 2 shot, but genuinely getting 1 shot.

3140772621.annotation: This item is good with characters that have high health, lifesteal, and can stay in the fight for LONG periods of time. Not for you. Also holy nerf.

3491236900.annotation: Actually a lot better than i thought, but still is lacking. You WON'T notice it working, but it actually slows build ups on enemies. (mina bite, wraith cards, infernus burn, viper venom, and MORE.

1047818222.annotation: Never be the first to fall asleep at a slumber party.

3399065363.annotation: Practically a must, set up item for Trophy Collector. If you aren't getting kills in lane early/rotating to get kills: SKIP.

2010028405.annotation: Bought of a lot of spirit characters for Gun Invest. "Do 50 free dmg" ahh type item. Interchangable first item with HVR and Grit.

1371725689.annotation: This disarms, is a quick cast, does 300~ dmg, and a slow. Combined w/Arctic Blast and pillow, you're doing guaranteed 1k dmg. CAN ALSO BE USED IN TAG ALONG FOR THE t2 BONUS. imo soon to be meta item.

1235347618.annotation: honestly it's not that bad... Only buy if versing heavy gun early. (I had vs graves/silver and it worked reliably)

3361811174.annotation: If we're talking about surviving, than this is it. Also 15% gun resist.

393974127.annotation: REALLY good potential with his pillow slow especially with any other slow item. Has good build up per shot ratio.

1342610602.annotation: 20% melee resist. Decent close range dmg. Will only buy if laning against melee

4053935515.annotation: Headshot booster scales pretty well to do consistent gun burst. Pairs good with mystic shot

3791587546.annotation: (BUFFED) 40% weapon dmg is crazy + -30% slow + 18% debuff resist will help with CC.

2095565695.annotation: Upgrade path. 50% weapon dmg. more importantly another -25% slow. You'll be close anyways, usually jumping from front-line to mid-line.

1144549437.annotation: Potential shred similar to mystic vulnerability, but helps teammates get lifesteal instead for less protections.

3361075077.annotation: I'm 50/50 on this. I see potenital w/spam shooting in-face (viper, ivy, silver ult, billy). But it scales terrible. Mid game it's TRASH and you rely on the enemy being able to hit their shots on rem.

4139877411.annotation: I rely on TG for escapes and NEVER buy any stamina now.

3270001687.annotation: If Phantom is on Cooldown, you have a backup

3190916303.annotation: Light meele after phantom striking to reduce spirit
